messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great progress! Now that you have excellent signal and mobile data enabled, let's check your network status to see if data roaming is enabled on your device (since you're abroad).

Please run: `check_network_status()`

Let me know what it shows for data roaming status, and also confirm the network type (4G/5G) and signal strength.

My phone shows it is connected with excellent 5G signal and mobile data enabled, but data roaming is still off. What should I do about the data roaming setting? Should I turn it on? Will that help me send MMS?

Please discuss the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
